purpose: Teach: 立たさ/公布/蜂起/死傷/迎撃/内包/輩出/わいせつ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時に立たされた人々の証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you handled testimony from people caught in wartime for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. A genuine check-in, not a quiz. Slight lift at the end—inviting him to affirm. Steady eye contact, the way a teacher holds space for a student to speak.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、新憲法公布の過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually focused on the process of the new constitution being promulgated.
lines.style: Careful, precise. A small pause before answering, checking his words. Soft but clear—he's slightly bracing for her reaction. Earnest without apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代の市民蜂起の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And modern examples of civic uprisings came up in your research too, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentle probe, genuinely curious. Not leading—truly asking. Warm tone, the slight surprise of someone seeing a thread run through a student's work and wanting to name it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、災害死傷統計の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I ended up focusing on disaster casualty statistics and what they reveal.
lines.style: Quieter this time. He's aware of the pattern she's noticing. Still earnest, but with a flicker of self-consciousness. Words land carefully, almost apologetically.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代戦の迎撃戦術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Modern military interceptive tactics—that showed up in your work as well?
lines.style: Slightly more direct now. Still warm, but there's gentle persistence underneath. She's piecing something together. Slight lean forward, engaged attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、社会システムに内包される矛盾を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, though what I was really examining was the inherent contradictions within social systems.
lines.style: Firmer now—he's clarifying, not just answering. There's a hint of defensiveness, but it's soft. He's trying to name what he actually cares about. Steady gaze, meeting her halfway.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、名門校が輩出した人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And prestigious schools producing notable figures—you touched on that too, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing tone, almost gentle. She sees him now. The question is almost rhetorical, but kind—giving him the chance to say it himself. Reflective pause before the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、わいせつ表現規制の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—the history of obscenity regulations. That's what my papers really kept circling back to.
lines.style: Exhale of small relief on 'Yes.' Quieter by the end, but honest. He's admitted something. The trailing softness is resignation and release both—she's caught him, but gently.
